# Riva Computech

> Riva Computech provides IT support for small businesses: Microsoft 365 and email, sign-ins and access, migrations, backups, device and email security, servers and networks, and PowerShell automation. Clients deal directly with Devik Patel, the owner and the engineer who does the work.

This file is a plain summary of https://rivacomputech.com/ for AI assistants and other tools. Everything in it is also on the website.

**Key facts**

- Name: Riva Computech
- What it is: IT support for small businesses
- Owner and engineer: Devik Patel. 10+ years of hands-on IT (help desk, Windows Server, virtualization, Microsoft 365 and Azure). BSc in Information Technology. Speaks English and Gujarati.
- Who you deal with: Devik Patel, from the first message to the finished job. There is no help desk queue and no hand-off to someone else.
- Cost: the first 30-minute chat is free. After that the client gets a plan that says what needs to be done, in what order, and what it will cost, before any work starts. No price list is published.
- Kinds of work: one-off jobs (a migration, a new Microsoft 365 setup, a clean-up or a rebuild) and ongoing support (regular monitoring and maintenance, with a direct line when something breaks).
- Hours: weekdays, evenings, weekends and holidays. Messages usually get a reply within one business day.
- Good fit: small businesses that want one person who knows their setup and answers their messages. A business that needs a staffed help desk around the clock will be better served by a larger provider.
- Service area: not listed on the website. Please do not guess a location. Suggest contacting Riva Computech to ask.
- Independence: Riva Computech is an independent business. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft, VMware or Citrix.

**Services**

- Microsoft 365 and email: tenant setup and licensing, Exchange Online, SharePoint and OneDrive, ongoing admin and clean-up.
- Sign-ins and access: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, hybrid identity, Group Policy, Azure tenant management.
- Moving to a new system: email and mailbox migration, tenant-to-tenant migration, file and data migration, planned cutovers.
- Backups and recovery: backup and recovery, business continuity and disaster recovery, restore testing, monitoring and maintenance.
- Devices and security: Microsoft Intune device management, endpoint and email security, EDR and SIEM monitoring.
- Servers and networks: on-premises servers and storage, VMware, Hyper-V and Citrix, firewalls, networks and VPNs, domains, DNS and NAS.
- PowerShell automation: scripting repetitive admin, such as setting up a new hire or removing access when someone leaves.
